**The University of Jordan**
**الجامعة الاردنية**

**Course Listings**

**Course Number:** 0401411  
**Course Title:** Miraculousness of the Holy Qur'an  
**Credit Hours:** 3  
**Prerequisites:** 0401111  
**Course Description:**  
This course discusses the concept of inimitability; moral challenges; magic challenge and its stages in the Qur'an; linguistic and literary inimitability of the Qur'an; the choice of the Qur'anic words; cohesion; coherence; scientific inimitability; difference between theories and facts, and properties of legislation in the Qur'an, principles of ethics.

---

**Course Number:** 0431412  
**Course Title:** Foundations of Exegesis and its Methods  
**Credit Hours:** 3  
**Prerequisites:** Not listed  
**Course Description:**  
This course aims to give a general introduction to the sources of exegesis, methods and styles of exegetes in their books of exegesis; difference between exegesis and interpretation; types of exegesis; characteristics of every school of exegesis; the best way of explaining the Qur'an; the development of exegesis in recent time.

---

**Course Number:** 0441421  
**Course Title:** Methods of Hadith Scholars  
**Credit Hours:** 3  
**Prerequisites:** Not listed  
**Course Description:**  
The course includes a study of the concept of methodology: its importance and history of writing the books of Hadith; methodology of certain Scholars of Hadith, such as Bukhari, Muslim, al-Tirmidhi, al-Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, Abu Dawud, al-Darimi and Malik; to know and discuss the conditions of every one of them in his book; this includes an applied and comparative study of these books.

---

**Course Number:** 0401422  
**Course Title:** Impugning and Crediting Hadith Transmitters  
**Credit Hours:** 3  
**Prerequisites:** Not listed  
**Course Description:**  
This course includes the concept of Al-Jarh wal-Ta'dil, its legitimacy, importance and the most eminent and distinguished scholars in this field.
